description: Analyze web pages and entire sites for SEO, accessibility, performance, and security compliance. Generate detailed reports and actionable issue lists to improve site quality and user experience. Track historical audit data to monitor improvements across multiple crawl sessions.

rawRecord.description: Analyze web pages and entire sites for SEO, accessibility, performance, and security compliance. Generate detailed reports and actionable issue lists to improve site quality and user experience. Track historical audit data to monitor improvements across multiple crawl sessions.

detail.description: Analyze web pages and entire sites for SEO, accessibility, performance, and security compliance. Generate detailed reports and actionable issue lists to improve site quality and user experience. Track historical audit data to monitor improvements across multiple crawl sessions.

tools.name: inspect_page
tools.description: Inspect a single web page for HTML/CSS quality, accessibility (WCAG/KWCAG), SEO, and performance/security. Returns scores, grades, and top issues. Takes 10-30 seconds.

url.description: The URL of the web page to inspect (must start with http:// or https://)

language.description: Response language: 'en' for English, 'ko' for Korean

accessibility_standard.description: Accessibility standard to check against (default: wcag_2.1_aa)

tools.name: inspect_site
tools.description: Start a site-wide crawl and inspection. Crawls links from the root URL and inspects each page. Returns a site_inspection_id for tracking. Use get_inspection to check results later.

url.description: Root URL of the site to crawl and inspect

language.description: Response language: 'en' for English, 'ko' for Korean

max_depth.description: Maximum link depth to crawl (default: 2, max: 3)

max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl (default: 20, max: 500, 0: unlimited)

accessibility_standard.description: Accessibility standard to check against (default: wcag_2.1_aa)

tools.name: get_inspection
tools.description: Get detailed inspection results by inspection ID. Works for both single-page and site inspections.

id.description: The inspection_id or site_inspection_id to retrieve

language.description: Response language: 'en' for English, 'ko' for Korean

tools.name: get_issues
tools.description: Get a filtered list of issues found during an inspection. Works with both single-page inspection_id and site_inspection_id. For site inspections, aggregates issues from all pages.

id.description: The inspection_id or site_inspection_id to get issues for

language.description: Response language: 'en' for English, 'ko' for Korean

page_url.description: For site inspections: filter issues by page URL substring

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: List recent inspection history. Optionally filter by URL substring.

url.description: Optional URL substring to filter results

language.description: Response language: 'en' for English, 'ko' for Korean
